title: Aquaculture issue #432: Reducing or Removing fish spawns in a 1.20.1 Server
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by kmkm1234]
The server is currently lagging due to entities and mobs, it's not excessive but it does cause the server to crash overtime. We are looking into how to reduce spawns, is there a way to reduce or shut off the mob spawns in Aquaculture? We'd like to not restart the server and remove the mod.

[comment by GirafiStudios (collaborator)]
Fish spawns can be altered by a datapack
https://github.com/TeamMetallurgy/Aquaculture/tree/AQ2-1.20.1/src/main/resources/data/aquaculture/forge/biome_modifier

Mods like In Control by McJty can also be used to alter it.
